blocks.text: FBR has substituted **Rule 160** of the Sales Tax Rules, 2006 for advance payments against supplies.

items: **Each advance:** issue an advance receipt invoice when you receive it
**Output tax:** declare it in the return for the period of receipt
**Instalments:** a separate invoice for each, electronically linked
**Final invoice:** refers to the advance invoices; no tax charged twice
**Rate:** at receipt for the advance, at supply for the balance

blocks.text: Check how your ERP records customer advances.
